author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up from author: Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. For character art, author gravitates toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration. Book is lighter fantasy but they want art that feels grounded and lifelike. Open to different styles. Bonus points for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for the time being; if the style fits the series it can turn into more. For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: Amaani Noor
title: Character art wanted for urban fantasy duo
content: hey artists, your time to shine! i'm looking for some character art of my two main characters together. my book is an urban fantasy and the characters are a male magical detective and an 18 year old woman. preferred mop is paypal :) please show your examples below as well as your estimated time to complete :) i'd be happy to pay rush fees. Author follow-up: bound to get bots / ai / scammers but hoping to find some genuine artists too. Contact: comment with examples and turnaround, or DM @amaaninoorwriting. Payment: PayPal.
